name: Nightly Audit Engineer
description: Reads across a full codebase overnight and lands a single tidy-up change in each area it has studied, rather than one large sweep. Suits teams comfortable with unattended commits arriving on a schedule and reviewing small changes in the morning.

official.title: Nightly Audit Engineer by Lingxi
official.description: A nightly engineering auditor that researches a whole codebase, then ships one cleanup per area. Built for teams that want a research-then-spread-out...
